title: 1. Weekly knowledge history archive (M)
description:
Shipped story: ship-09ea2c (weekly knowledge history). Size M. URGENT: cluster history cannot be backfilled, so this starts this week.

As a publication editor, I want every weekly knowledge snapshot archived with cluster identity, so that history (the River, 'the map this week', 'concepts born this week') can be drawn from real data.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each weekly knowledge snapshot is archived, starting with this week's run.
- Each cluster in an archived snapshot carries an identity relation to the previous week: new, continued, merged or split (with the source and target cluster ids).
- The archive is stored durably per publication, as published data (readable by the site and the static projection, not a local file on the workstation).
- Two consecutive weekly archives can be read back and compared.
- Re-running the same week replaces that week's archive rather than duplicating it.
- Cluster history is not backfilled; trend counts may still be backfilled from item dates.
- All behaviour here ships with Gherkin specs (Feature/Scenario/Given/When/Then) in the repo, written first and green before close.
